decisions.reason: It clearly builds on the firm's established floor-care knowledge, the firm has its own R&D to improve it, and its move from a mention to a dedicated page suggests strengthening market commitment.

This maintenance oil is closely related to the firm's core wood-floor expertise and service offer, so absorptive capacity is high, although its weaker website prominence suggests a slightly higher rationalisation risk than the strongest products.

As a care product for oiled wood floors, it fits the firm's installed base and technical know-how very well, and the dedicated 2024 page indicates the product is being actively supported rather than prepared for withdrawal.

A moisture-protection underlay complements the firm's flooring systems and installation guidance, making it learnable and improvable within existing capabilities, though its limited web emphasis leaves some modest chance of portfolio trimming.

The underlay foam remains related to the firm's flooring system business and benefits from existing technical and channel knowledge, but as a less differentiated accessory it faces the highest, though still minority, risk of being dropped.

An oak parquet floor is very close to the firm's core manufacturing and design capabilities, and in a growing industry with in-house R&D and hiring there is strong reason to retain and refine such a central product.
